events.title: Paint Night
events.description: You' re on your own, kid, but not tonight—paint alongside fellow Swifties and let your artistic side shine! We'll host more exciting Swiftville events throughout November, but this paint night is "the best day" to start! So grab a brush, choose your favourite Taylor era for inspiration, and let’s "paint the whole town" together! See you there, Swifties!

events.title: Bracelet Making
events.description: Let's prepare for the eras tour!  Inspired by the empowering message from Taylor’s song "You’re On Your Own, Kid", we’re inviting all Swifties to come together, make friendship bracelets, and embrace the spirit of connection that defines the Swiftie community. Enter your information below to enter our giveaway!!

events.title: Eras Tour
events.description:
Let's Get Ready for it! This is the perfect way to prepare for Taylor’s Eras Tour in Toronto and enjoy the evening with the Swiftie community. Bring your friends, dress to impress, and get ready for a night full of Taylor Swift fun! 
 📍 Location: A145, HMC Campus 🕔 Time: 5:00 PM onwards 📅 Date: November 11, 2024

events.title: Fall Clubs Fair
events.description: Join us at the Fall Clubs Fair to discover the Sheridan Swiftie Club and all the exciting activities we have planned for the semester! Whether you're a longtime Swiftie or new to the fandom, this is the perfect opportunity to connect with fellow fans, learn about our upcoming events, and find out how you can get involved. Don't miss out on the fun – come say hi and let's make this semester unforgettable together!
events.location: Student Atrium - Sheridan College, Trafalgar Campus

events.title: End of an Era Docu-Series Screening
events.description: Join us for a special screening of Taylor Swift's 'The End of an Era' documentary series. This exclusive event celebrates the conclusion of Taylor's incredible journey and the beginning of new adventures. Come together with fellow Swifties to watch and reflect on the moments that defined an era. Limited seats available - RSVP required!

events.title: The Life of a hacker: Karaoke Night @Hackville 2026
events.description: Join us for a night of fun and music at Hackville 2026! Unleash your inner Swiftie and sing your heart out to your favorite Taylor Swift hits. Whether you're a seasoned hacker or just looking to have a good time, this karaoke night is the perfect way to connect with fellow hackers and Swift fans alike. Don't miss out on the chance to showcase your talent and enjoy an unforgettable evening!
